## Primary Competencies

- **Cross-Platform Mobile & Client Architecture:** Production Flutter, Dart, Riverpod state modeling, offline-first sync pipelines, determinism.
- **Agentic AI & Model Context Protocol (MCP):** MCP tool harness design, isolated execution environments, Agent SDLC paradigms, GitHub automation.
- **Enterprise Backend Services:** Python (FastAPI, telemetry, async workers), Java (enterprise concurrency, Spring Boot), C# (.NET Core structured exceptions & resilience).
- **Distributed Commerce & Data Storage:** Multi-tenant PostgreSQL schemas, Redis caching, Supabase realtime subscriptions, Razorpay/Stripe payment gateways.
- **Operational Intelligence:** Power BI DAX modeling, ETL analytics pipelines, systems telemetry.

## Key Projects & Case Studies

- [CloudPower Ecosystem](https://alex.runs-on.dev/projects): Unified 4-tier ecosystem spanning Flutter client apps, FastAPI backend microservices, real-time sync, and operational monitoring.
- [HimAmrit Shopping Platform](https://himamritshop.in): Production multi-tenant e-commerce system featuring offline sync, resilient state machines, inventory locks, and secure payment processing.
- [School Landing Platform](https://school.alex.runs-on.dev/): Responsive educational institution web portal with interactive program exploration and accessibility-first architecture.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Harness](https://alex.runs-on.dev/projects): Custom agent runtime providing isolated filesystem operations, sandboxed CLI execution, and verifiable telemetry for autonomous coding agents.
